name: @laminapdf/tokens
description: Lamina PDF's Paper design tokens: the design language's colours, type, space and sizes as CSS custom properties (--paper-*) and typed constants, with the light, dark and high-contrast themes, four accents and four page appearances. Workspace-only for now.

scripts.test: node scripts/generate.ts --check && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts
